name: Permutation Proof for Projection and Warp
definition: A mathematical proof demonstrating that the projection matrix $P$ and warp matrix $W$ can be permuted (applied as $W*P*S$ instead of $P*W*S$) in the perspective shear-warp algorithm, provided specific constraints on $W$ are met.
summary: This mathematical proof verifies that projection and warp matrices commute in the shear-warp algorithm when specific warp matrix constraints are met.
